import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;
    static final long INF = (long)1e18;
    static int n;
    static BigDecimal[][] p = new BigDecimal[7][7];

    static long po(int x) {
        return 1L << x;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        setIO();
        n = readInt();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                p[i][j] = new BigDecimal(readDouble()).divide(new BigDecimal(100));
            }
        }
        long[] no = new long[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < (1 << n); j++) {
                if (((j >> i) & 1) == 0) {
                    no[i] |= po(j);
                }
            }
        }
        Map<Long, BigDecimal> m = new HashMap<>();
        m.put(1L, BigDecimal.ONE);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            Map<Long, BigDecimal> M = new HashMap<>();
            for (Map.Entry<Long, BigDecimal> t : m.entrySet()) {
                long key = t.getKey();
                BigDecimal val = t.getValue();
                for (int j = 0; j < (1 << n); j++) {
                    long res = 0;
                    BigDecimal prob = BigDecimal.ONE;
                    for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) {
                        if (((j >> k) & 1) != 0) {
                            prob = prob.multiply(p[i][k]);
                            res |= (no[k] << (1 << k));
                        } else {
                            prob = prob.multiply(BigDecimal.ONE.subtract(p[i][k]));
                        }
                    }
                    M.put(res, M.getOrDefault(res, BigDecimal.ZERO).add(val.multiply(prob)));
                }
            }
            m = M;
        }
        System.out.println(m.getOrDefault(po((1 << n) - 1), BigDecimal.ZERO));
    }

    static void setIO() throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        // No file IO needed, just standard input
    }

    static int readInt() throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        return Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
    }

    static double readDouble() throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        return Double.parseDouble(br.readLine());
    }
}
